settings.heading: See what’s in your jar
settings.lead: Every jar carries a batch number. Enter it below to see that batch’s certificate of analysis (CoA).
settings.notice: [Certificates of analysis per batch are being requested from the manufacturer. Until they are added, any number shows the “not found” message.]

settings.help: You’ll find it [location on the jar, e.g. on the base next to the best-before date]. It looks like [format, e.g. TS-0000].

settings.heading: What’s a certificate of analysis?
settings.text:
A certificate of analysis is a laboratory report for one production batch. It records what was measured in that batch and the result.

[What each certificate covers, e.g. live culture count and microbiological checks: to be confirmed with the manufacturer]

Questions about a batch? Contact us with the batch number and we’ll help.
